help.logDiagnostic: Path to RAP-LP diagnostic information. If specified, diagnostic information is written to the file as JSON.
help.dex: Path to RAP-LP diagnostic information. If specified, diagnostic information is written to the file as Excel.
help.sarif: Path to the RAP-LP SARIF report (.sarif or .json). If specified, rule results are written to the file in SARIF format.

help.enableUrlValidation: [api-mode] Enable validation of files by URL.
help.urlValidationConfigFile: [api-mode] Path to the URL validation configuration file. Falls back to ./urlValidationConfig.cjs

help.lang: Language for CLI output (sv or en)
help.failOnError: [cli mode] Exit with code 22 if any MUST (SKALL) requirement is not met.
help.failOnWarning: [cli mode] Exit with code 22 if any MUST (SKALL) or SHOULD (BÖR) requirement is not met.
help.minConformance: [cli mode] Exit with code 22 if the rule conformance (1-100%) is below the given value. Not applicable rules are excluded.
